notes: Tuition: the page states only the Parcoursup fee of 178 EUR/year ('Par année 178 euros'); the cited quote does not identify it as the differentiated rate for non-EU students, so this amount may not apply to a Moroccan Bac holder. The Campus France Maroc page (https://www.maroc.campusfrance.org/le-cout-des-etudes-les-bourses) mentions 2 902 euros/year for a Licence cycle for 'un étudiant extra communautaire (Maroc)', but that is a general figure for French public institutions, not this programme. The application route for this programme is Études en France / Campus France, not Parcoursup; the Parcoursup page's deadline ('2 juin 2026') and platform are therefore not extracted here.
